issue.title: repo value-kind completion cannot offer linked, sidecar, or external repos because sase.repo_inventory pulls sase.sdd/ACE/rich
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-oc.5 (epic sase-oc, shell completion) as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP and triaged by that epic's land agent.

ROOT CAUSE: src/sase/repo_inventory.py imports sase.sdd.store at module scope, and sase.sdd's package __init__ pulls sase.ace and rich. The completion candidates fast path forbids that import set (tests/main/test_completion_candidates_contract.py asserts no sase.ace / rich / textual / sase.main.parser in sys.modules after the fast path runs), so src/sase/completion/candidates/catalog.py::_repo_candidates cannot call collect_repo_inventory.

IMPACT: 'sase repo open <TAB>' and every other repo-kinded slot offers only primary project display names and workspace checkout basenames. Configured linked repos (sase-core, sase-github, sase-telegram, sase-nvim, chezmoi, …), sidecars, and external gh:owner/repo references never appear, even though the /sase_repo workflow makes them the values users type most.

SCOPE: make repo_inventory's sase.sdd.store import lazy (or add a Rust inventory binding), then extend _repo_candidates to offer linked/sidecar/external repo names with their kind as the description. Add the kind to the contract test's latency parametrization and confirm it holds the budget.
